<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-1705-04-66" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="213.111.313.23 de la rtsod pa spang pa (17b3)"/>
       gsum pa rtsod pa spang pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> na re byas pa la rgyus bskyed kyis byas par mtshon pa na mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la don ldog gzhan du ma gyur nas mi srid pa yin na | mtshan nyid tha <lb n="17b4"/> snyad du mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid mtshon bya don ldog gzhi la grub yin na rgyus bskyed mtshan nyid skyon med du 'gyur te | rang gi mtshon bya don ldog yin pa dang rdzas dbyer ‹med› ldog pa tha dad kyis gzhi la grub tsam tshang pa'i phyir dang 'dod na don log gzhan du ma gyur nas mi srid pa yin pa nyams so || yang zung 1 rten pa mtshan gzhi'i mtshan nyid yin na byas pa mtshan gzhi yin <lb n="17b5"/> par 'gyur te rgyus bskyed dang shes bya'i tha snyad zung 1 rten pa'i phyir ro || 'dod na mtshan gzhi ma yin par 'gyur te rgyu bskyed dang byas pa zung 1 mi rten pa'i phyir ro || yang rtags dang khyab pa 2 ga khas blangs 'dod pa la khas blangs kyis bsal pa yin no zhes zer ba ni 
         
            ma yin te |</seg></TEI>
